entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent data into a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading strategy (Abstract, Overview, Details) to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows across more than 25 LLM providers and multiple storage backends. It has achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark and provides SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform enables persistent long-term memory by building searchable knowledge graphs from text, code, and conversation data. It is designed to run locally on CPU without requiring LLM API keys and supports custom ontologies for structured memory.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, Supermemory features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It supports multi-modal extraction from diverse file types and maintains auto-updated user profiles with stable facts.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain provides keyword retrieval, semantic search, and synthesis with citations through a typed knowledge graph. It exposes memory to agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) over local connections or Tailscale.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, serving as the upstream foundation for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with dedicated SDKs and integrates with Claude Code, Cursor-compatible clients, and MCP.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It employs a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, ensuring sub-100ms response times.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database for local storage. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports sub-millisecond operations via MCP or a Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system provides a seven-layer memory architecture for Hermes, utilizing Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite for local infrastructure. It includes structured facts and an auto-curated wiki, using a Ground Truth hierarchy to prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first traces and outcome-gated context bundles. It supports various providers including Anthropic and vLLM, offering specific entry points for Hermes and MCP clients.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from persistent message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from 35 different coding agents to enable searching through months of past interactions. It operates locally without models or cloud servers and can report if files modified in previous sessions have since been changed.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers for persistent agent state.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI offers a local-first identity and memory layer that syncs secrets and context across multiple AI harnesses and models. It supports real-time ingestion from platforms like GitHub and Obsidian, achieving 97.6% accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores information as plain-text YAML engrams on local disk for multi-agent systems. It utilizes an MCP server integration to provide tool portability and hybrid retrieval via BM25 and local embeddings.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that captures agent decisions and preferences using a local GGUF observer model. It functions entirely without cloud dependencies, combining BM25, vector search, and cross-encoder reranking for retrieval.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses a five-tier SQLite schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes an SDK, CLI, and a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes long-context inference by reordering text and multimodal data for prefix-cache sharing in engines like vLLM and llama.cpp. It provides a context index for deduplication and cache-aware scheduling specifically for agentic AI workflows.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It maintains state by tracking contradictions, performing idempotent writes, and using a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis with full citations and provenance across sessions. It stores data in SQLite with rebuildable Markdown projections and supports portable archives for merging wiki data between environments.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements anticipatory memory by watching agent session logs to prefetch context into a local SQLite-vec cache. It is an MCP-native server that uses GGUF models via node-llama-cpp for local-first storage and retrieval.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to manage agent state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma. It processes queries to provide the agent with a purpose-built evidence packet for informed decision-making.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider implements reflective memory using semantic search and ranked graph traversal to navigate bidirectional relationships between notes. It supports automated indexing for diverse formats including codebases and multimedia with OCR capabilities.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to optimize prompt efficiency, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to reduce schema token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated token savings and integrates with native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: This Git-backed layer provides durable context for coding agents by storing information in plain Markdown rather than native memory. It ensures data integrity through a system of hash-checked proposals and receipts for all reviewed context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single embedded graph database file to manage memories with importance-weighted recall. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional entity extraction to surface high-priority entries during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A community-focused plugin that offers episodic memory with immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides high transparency by maintaining a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory and prefetch operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables budget-bound agent wallets to handle x402 payments across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It operates without the need for a backend, database, or API keys, facilitating direct stablecoin transactions.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and scripts to provide tools for knowledge retrieval and neighbor traversal. It supports automatic tool-OKF generation through detached model calls to streamline local capability routing.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Focusing on cross-session continuity, this provider uses native lifecycle hooks for pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots. It employs a local SQLite layer for reliable caching and allows agents to read memories from other connected instances.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes Agent. It features tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This tool provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for searching, syncing, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory provider that defaults to AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during the message compression process.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop for agent memory that identifies stale information and contradictions within plain markdown files. It generates evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review, utilizing a local git repository to track and revert changes to the memory state.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while enforcing TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development methodology that integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for Hermes Agent via the DeepSeek Harness. It enables agents to export prototypes into various formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agentic operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to convert codebases, schemas, and natural language descriptions into draw.io diagrams. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and is accessible via CLI or an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router for protocol skills and adds a dedicated layer for verification and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process for verification. It offers five voice profiles and supports rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes for prose adjustment.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos to facilitate collective skill evolution. It integrates with Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs, providing a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and Codex specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,176 markdown-based skills across 35 professions that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring telemetry or accounts. It provides ready-to-paste exports for various assistants including Cursor and MCP clients.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with other environments like OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage new skills via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro coordinates agent teams using the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage. It distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes and skills for long-running tasks.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on stored work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource offers guides for VPS production and automation alongside skills compatible with the agentskills.io standard. It supports integrations for communication platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These developer tools follow the Agent Skills specification to enable interactions with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The skills are designed for oracle network and smart contract integration and install via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. It includes specific prompting guidelines to optimize generative outputs.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and APIs into compliant skills with instructions linked to specific source lines and pinned commits. It provides lifecycle tooling for version-pinned management and skill export.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that compiles natural language into reviewable files using a deterministic compiler. It supports multiple AI model providers and includes integrity verification for execution traces.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills with a Python client and CLI that supports recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features utilizing TON payments for skill transactions.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress and decision tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A centralized hub for autonomous resource discovery that allows users to browse, search, and install community skills with one click. It operates 24/7 on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By optimizing skill selection, it reduces token usage and provides graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive Model Context Protocol client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token consumption. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution system uses an MCP connection to provide agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: A specialized code review skill that uses three parallel subagents to conduct adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It triages findings through deterministic pre-scans and verifies issues via proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces like Discord and Telegram to improve quality across five dimensions. It supports 97 languages and can reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses three parallel agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project provides a systematic investigation protocol for debugging and reproduction through multi-story task decomposition. It uses a Python goal engine for state management and enforces mandatory evidence-based verification gates.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: A comprehensive cybersecurity suite that equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 industry frameworks and standards to address real-world exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of skill directories and uses SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add persistent memory and session management to agents like Claude Code and Cursor. The toolkit includes specialized utilities for worktree recovery, architectural reviews, and skill scaffolding.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal CLIs and web apps, optimizing output files to remain under an 8 MB target size.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators to prevent regressions without requiring external services.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files while validating them against runtime-specific profiles. It monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect and prevent field drift in skill definitions.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This suite provides skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment for agentskills.io compliant clients. It includes a workspace Postgres database and an MCP server designed for browser-based OAuth authentication.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed to assist with e-commerce material creation and structured data extraction from PDFs.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project enables deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards for handling paid machine-to-machine requests.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This quality assurance tool tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to confirm that a skill operates as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows agents to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties or managing their own bounty boards via x402. It facilitates payments and context purchasing without requiring accounts or API keys, governed by user-defined price ceilings.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills for accessing structured web data across 31 platforms. It utilizes a hosted MCP server to support clients including Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansions with user interests while producing structured summaries that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes a structured debate format between bullish and bearish researchers, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents who approve final trades.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted orchestration platform that governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, supporting both local Node.js and Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities. It ensures persistent background execution using tmux and provides secure sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms supported by durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage and visualize agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task statuses and a live stream of agent reasoning and tool execution. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, and infrastructure roles. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles through a integrated Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code, specifically orchestrating TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It manages structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking to optimize agent performance.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, compete for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack that uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing files. It includes an MCP server and automatically synchronizes the index on every file change to ensure data remains current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, via a Terminal User Interface. It allows developers to visualize their consumption and optionally submit data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget monitors real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and over 40 other AI tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and provides historical breakdowns categorized by tool, model, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It features 36 distinct skills for deployment and monitoring, operating autonomously while requiring founder approval for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-created themes and skins to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art through a YAML-based configuration system.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging and register human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through a supervisor sidebar that manages approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that scans agent configurations and system prompts for schema mismatches or contradictory directions. It supports HERM v1.1 scoring and exports findings in formats like SARIF and GitLab Code Quality.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code to enhance agent memory.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent operations. It features over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, supported by an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining unique local tools and instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It enables zero-cost operation using free models and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping configurations, credentials, and memory archives into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles the transfer of SOUL.md and skills while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It detects performance drift using config-aware baselines and supports both passive zero-token analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for generating revenue through Hermes Agent, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network local runtime by default. It enforces a strict security model requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds offline voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, featuring an open mic with wake word support and adaptive turn-taking. It functions without API keys or accounts, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin enables multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities for Hermes Agent via the MemOS API. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux for handling configurations across multiple agents including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It facilitates one-click switching between different API providers to streamline environment management.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork application that enables autonomous multi-step tasks through built-in or external agents like Hermes Agent. It features user approval workflows and file access, with remote accessibility via WebUI, Telegram, and other messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JS, this interface provides 1:1 parity with Hermes CLI features for web and mobile use. The layout includes a three-panel system for managing chat, active sessions, and workspace browsing without the need for frameworks or bundlers.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app facilitates the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent using local backends or remote API connections. It features a streaming chat UI with token tracking and provides management for 14 toolsets, memory systems, and environment profiles.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: This web dashboard supports multiple runtimes including Hermes and Claude Code while offering unified configuration for 10 communication platforms like WhatsApp and Matrix. It includes a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It integrates a full file browser with Monaco, a PTY terminal, and dedicated managers for memory, skills, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration. It can be deployed as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container, with native mobile clients for iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for system repair and shell access. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs alongside an embedded terminal.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application is built with Tauri and Rust, featuring a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering while providing native window and process management for chat and memory.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser tabs to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes for site-aware drafting. It supports multi-agent switching, bot mode, and session-synced chat histories with opt-in browser control.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive self-hosted Hermes agents via HTTPS or Tailscale. It enables real-time chat, task management, and server file system browsing without tracking or subscriptions.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for monitoring token usage and latency alongside a live workspace for tracking code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It tracks per-session token burn and estimated costs using a locally built search index that does not upload telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports the management of profiles, skills, and toolsets, and includes a kanban board for agentic task management.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a mobile-first UI capable of spawning five concurrent background agent instances. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and uses dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for Telegram validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a built-in workflow engine and includes 100 tools for tasks such as TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes an integrated file browser and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard focused on process activity, session costs, and the inspection of conversation histories. It provides read-only access to environment variables and allows users to review skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and supports model switching. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated one-click installations and streaming SSE responses.
